text: This report recommends the appointment of one member to the Toronto Atmospheric Fund’s Audit Committee.

The Board of Directors of the Toronto Atmospheric Fund: 1. Appointed the individual listed in Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (April 12, 2024) from the Chief Executive Officer, Toronto Atmospheric Fund as a member of the Audit Committee. 2. Instructed the City Clerk to make the appointee’s name public once appointed by the Board. The name of the individual appointed to the Audit Committee, as set out in Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (April 12, 2024) from the Chief Executive Officer, Toronto Atmospheric Fund, is now public as follows: Audit Committee Jean Olemou
